resources.string: Connect App Store Connect or Google Play to start keeping your apps alive.
No apps in this account yet.
Keys are stored in this device’s secure storage and are only ever sent to Apple and Google.
Create a key in App Store Connect → Users and Access → Integrations. The App Manager role is enough.
Create a service account key (JSON) in Google Cloud, enable the Google Play Developer Reporting API, and invite the service account email in Play Console → Users and permissions.
